Subject: Re: Sudden p95/p99 spike after model variant swap - urgent

Triage notes: I've pulled the traces for the window and see two correlated signals:
1) KV cache miss rate for zh-v2b is ~3.8x higher than zh-v2a for the same traffic slice. That lines up with increased upstream latency.
2) The inference kernel path selected for ~20% of requests on zh-v2b is a different quantization path that shows higher tail latency for sequences >256 tokens. Our preflight didn't exercise the longer-token tails for this customer.

Immediate mitigation options (ranked):
A) Targeted traffic split: route high-p95 traffic (identified by route tag X-route:dialog-shortcuts) back to zh-v2a while leaving other traffic on zh-v2b. Low blast radius and immediate improvement expected.
B) Full rollback to zh-v2a for the account until we push a zh-v2b patch (requires CS approval).
C) Temporary auto-scaling bump (add dedicated capacity) — will reduce queuing but not address kernel/path inefficiency.

I recommend option A as fastest. I can prepare the route config; need SRE to apply it and Ops to confirm degraded routes.

Marcus Lin
Product - Inference Optimizations
